name: Care Manager
description: Looks after someone's medicines and appointments with the family: dose-time nudges, an alert if a dose is missed, pill counts with refill warnings, appointment reminders and a nightly summary.

settings.label: Who you care for
settings.help: Their name as the family says it, e.g. Mum or Grandpa Raj.

settings.label: Medicines
settings.help: One per line: name | times | pills left (optional), e.g. "Metformin 500mg | 08:00, 20:00 | 60".

settings.label: Their phone
settings.help: Optional. Adds a one-tap call to missed-dose alerts, e.g. +91 98765 43210.

settings.label: Pharmacy phone
settings.help: Optional. Adds a one-tap call to refill alerts.

settings.label: Doctor's phone
settings.help: Optional. Adds a one-tap call to appointment reminders.

settings.label: Refill warning (days)
settings.help: Warn when this many days of pills are left. Default 7.

settings.label: Missed-dose alert after (min)
settings.help: Minutes after a dose time with no confirmation before the family is alerted. Default 60.
